name: ANSI/IEEE Latched lever-operated switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of latched lever-operated switch: this representation distinguishes a lever actuator with a maintained or latched operated state.
description: This reference locates latched lever-operated switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. This representation distinguishes a lever actuator with a maintained or latched operated state. The public library uses HPB11LSL for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
